messages.content: I've been thinking about how much of my personality is actually just trauma responses.
Honestly, that's a genuinely heavy but common realization to have. What made you start noticing it?
I realized my 'independence' might actually just be fear of relying on anyone.
That's honestly a really brave thing to see in yourself - and worth knowing, independence born from fear looks different from independence born from genuine preference.
How do I even tell the difference at this point?
Honestly, notice how it feels when you do rely on someone and it goes well - if it feels relieving rather than threatening, that's actually a good sign you can build from.
